title: 同城游美女捕鱼
description: Brand-new casual fishing hit Beauty Fishing brings you an immersive deep-sea world. Every fishing ground is filled with unique fish species and powerful sea overlords. The gameplay is easy to pick up — tap the screen to fire cannonballs and catch sea creatures. Enjoy ultra-high 10,000x multipliers, and striking exclusive visual effects trigger once you defeat overlords, delivering an incredibly thrilling fishing rush.
description_short: Beauty Fishing is a casual fishing game with immersive deep-sea scenes, various fish and sea bosses. Tap to fire cannons, hit overlords for full-screen coin bursts. Unlock beautiful heroines, unique fisheries and fish collections. Daily check-ins and princess events give free coins.
